title: Require execution delegation regression tests in Accounts CI
description: Given an enabled Accounts deployment with the native fixture built and verified, when required CI runs its persisted isolation step, then it also runs accounts/execution-delegation.test.ts and fails if that suite fails. Given no approved operator or execution-pair activation, when this CI correction is adopted, then runtime registries, grants, IAM and OAuth remain unchanged.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Implemented workflow-only correction c582908 on the isolated execution-delegation review branch. The required enabled-Accounts native step now includes execution-delegation.test.ts. YAML/gate validation passes, and the exact combined command passes all108 native checks. Original owner source and auth implementation remain untouched; runtime activation remains disabled. Integration commit is separate from imported owner code for coordination.

right_now_summary: Accounts CI now runs execution-delegation tests, while runtime activation and authorization remain unchanged.
